cards.title: Main Bearings and Connecting Rod Bearings
cards.body: We replace main bearings and connecting rod bearings as standard during a rebuild.

cards.title: Complete Gasket and Seal Set
cards.body: All gaskets and seals are replaced as standard to ensure a complete seal.

cards.title: Timing Chain Components
cards.body: We replace timing chain components where required during the rebuild.

cards.title: Oil Filter Housing Gasket
cards.body: The oil filter housing gasket is replaced as standard during a rebuild. Crankshaft, cylinder head, VANOS components, oil pump, cooling system components, fuel injectors, high-pressure fuel pump (HPFP), throttle actuators, PCV system.
